{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Well, that's why the government instituted the Protocols. Pilots who wish to duel must demonstrate that both will benefit from a duel. |Cheriss ke Hanadi to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
'''The Protocols ''' were a set of rules established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] in the hopes of preventing the loss of too many [[Adumari]]  [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] due to honor duels.<ref name="soa" />

A facet of the protocols dictates that a new pilot may not duel an experienced pilot since only the new pilot would benefit, either by receiving training from the fight or earning a chance to kill a more prestigious opponent. But if the new pilot has invented a new maneuver or tactic which the older pilot could benefit from facing, the duel might be approved.<ref name="soa" />
